requirements.title: MASK arguments select elements operated on by array intrinsics
requirements.definition: Some array intrinsics have an optional logical MASK argument used to select elements of one or more arguments to be operated on.

pending.mask-argument-logical-selector: Use an exact masked reduction with a nontrivial true/false mask and mutate the mask pattern while values remain fixed.
pending.mask-selects-operated-elements: Use an exact masked reduction with a nontrivial true/false mask and mutate the mask pattern while values remain fixed.

requirements.title: Unselected MASK elements need not be defined
requirements.definition: Any element not selected by MASK need not be defined when the function is invoked.

pending.unselected-mask-elements-need-not-be-def: Use only intrinsics whose unselected elements are not evaluated as array expressions first; assert selected exact results and never read the unselected value.

requirements.title: MASK affects only function value, not prior array-expression evaluation
requirements.definition: MASK affects only the function value and does not affect evaluation, before invocation, of arguments that are array expressions.

pending.mask-affects-only-function-value: Compare exact masked values for already-defined arrays. Evaluation-suppression negatives have no portable oracle under this unit alone and remain source controls without another portable owner.
pending.mask-does-not-suppress-prior-array-expre: Compare exact masked values for already-defined arrays. Evaluation-suppression negatives have no portable oracle under this unit alone and remain source controls without another portable owner.

review_rationale: Source registration for Clause 16 general text, 16 through 16.8: intrinsic procedure classes and general rules, the bit and numeric models, atomic and collective subroutines, and the standard generic and specific name tables (batch178). This opens Clause 16. Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; round 1 found conditional pending plans for the atomic and collective STAT semantics, now resolved into explicit decisions: image-dependent facets are out of scope for single-image fixtures by user decision, and the 'any other error' STAT values have no portable oracle because such an error cannot be induced portably. C1601 and C1602 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
